title: Opposite compensated drift in pinned extended Selberg screw representation
scope: Limited to the printed coefficient of +iCt outside the integral in arXiv:2209.12832v2, page 6, §5.1. The kernel, real-part criterion, and infinite divisibility survive translation. Journal wording is unverified.
explicit_witness: F = 1 + 2i·4^(−s) satisfies S♯, with GRH following by absolute values. Here B = −log 2 and A = 9 log 2/17. The printed C is −8 log 2/17 and the required C is +8 log 2/17.

title: Real-descent obstruction needs an obstructed Artin sector or a universal family
scope: Theorem 2.13 is read in its global functorial context. Its obstruction does not extend to a blanket claim about an isolated operator over ℚ. The positive pairing remains conjectural.
